races.paceDynamic: Tangara Bay will set a steady, sustainable pace from the front with no pressure from confirmed leaders. The prominent brigade of Ned In The Park, Former Flame, Mic Drop, Strange Currency and Private Policy will track within striking distance but none are likely to pressure the leader early. This creates an ideal scenario for hold-up horses like Thisain'tthat, Spellacy's Cross, Paradise Lost, The Guinness Boys and King Gris to get into contention. The lack of early pace pressure strongly favours hold-up horses and closers who can time their runs effectively in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominant
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady throughout and kick comes late
scenarios.body: Tangara Bay's uncontested lead sets up perfectly for closers to sweep past in the final furlong. The lack of early pace allows hold-up horses to conserve energy and time their challenges.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Tangara Bay's class tells and no sustained challenge materializes
scenarios.body: The sustainable early pace allows Tangara Bay to maintain stamina reserves for a strong finish. His recent good form and front-running style prove decisive when others fail to mount serious threats.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners applies pressure from halfway
scenarios.body: The early move puts Tangara Bay under pressure and sets up a true staying test. Former Flame or Ned In The Park benefit from tracking the pace and having first run on the closers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Tangara Bay goes too slow and field bunches completely
scenarios.body: An ultra-slow pace leads to a cavalry charge where the strongest finisher prevails regardless of position. King Gris or Paradise Lost benefit from having Jack Kennedy or superior finishing speed.

races.paceDynamic: Rusty Harkness and My Gaffer are confirmed front runners who will contest the early lead, with both possessing legitimate pace credentials. Forceonmyown and Rajsalad sit prominently behind the leaders, while the majority of this 15-runner field (Better Times, Ontheropes, Verdant Place, Rhythmic Tune, Ballyglass Beauty, Cullig, Roxboro River, Wakey Wakey Man) are hold-up performers who need the race to develop. The two pace-setters will create an honest gallop over this extended 2m7f trip, but with so many hold-up horses, the pace may not be truly searching. This race shape strongly favors prominent racers and early hold-up horses who can track the pace without getting buried in the pack.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Honest Pace Suits
scenarios.trigger: If Rusty Harkness and My Gaffer set a true gallop without killing each other early
scenarios.body: The extended trip allows both leaders to last longer while creating the strong pace needed to set up the race properly. Prominent racers like Forceonmyown and Midnight Our Fred can capitalize, while the best hold-up horses get their preferred setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leaders Collapse Late
scenarios.trigger: If the two front runners go too hard in the early stages
scenarios.body: Both pace-setters weaken dramatically in the final half-mile, creating a cavalry charge from the back markers. The strongest staying hold-up horses with proven stamina reserves will surge through the tiring leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Benefits One
scenarios.trigger: If one of the two leaders (likely Rusty Harkness) can shake off My Gaffer mid-race
scenarios.body: The survivor of the pace duel gets an uncontested lead and proves too strong, while the prominent racers struggle to bridge the gap. The winner comes from the early pace battle itself.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl Finish
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go steady early, creating a slow-run race
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine pace turns this into a sprint finish where class and recent form matter most. Hold-up horses with tactical speed get ideal conditions for a late burst.

watchPoints.text: Rusty Harkness and My Gaffer setting unsustainable fractions early could set up dramatic late collapse
Better Times and Rhythmic Tune getting good positions early as key hold-up horses with recent form

Ontheropes and Getaway Charlie finding cover early despite amateur/conditional jockeys in large field

races.paceDynamic: Single Edition stands alone as the confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the outset, with Baltinglass Hill and Katzoff likely to track just behind in prominent positions. With 16 of 19 runners preferring hold-up tactics, the early pace will be controlled and sustainable rather than punishing. The large field of hold-up horses will create a wall of traffic in behind, making clean runs at premium and putting emphasis on positioning entering the home straight. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable scrimmaging and horses with proven stamina to finish, as the sustained gallop will test staying power over this extended 2m1f trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Single Edition and Baltinglass Hill maintain steady fractions without pressure
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows prominent runners to travel comfortably and kick clear before the hold-up brigade can organize. Those tracking the leaders avoid traffic problems and have first run on the field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Tests Stamina
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens mid-race and becomes a genuine staying test
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop over 2m1f finds out the less genuine stayers and sets up horses with proven stamina reserves. Class and experience become decisive factors in a battle of attrition.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits Wide
scenarios.trigger: If the large field of hold-up horses creates a cavalry charge and bunching
scenarios.body: Clean runs become vital as multiple horses attempt to make their moves simultaneously in the straight. Those who get a clear passage or race wide have significant advantages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Kick From Back
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure speed contest over the final half-mile, suiting horses with the quickest turn of foot regardless of earlier positioning. Class and finishing speed triumph over tactics.

races.paceDynamic: Pinot Gris is the only confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the start, likely getting an uncontested lead on the yielding to soft ground. The prominent runners Son Of Anarchy, Goldinthemountains and Nytol will sit just behind, but none are aggressive pace-pressers. This sets up a sustainable gallop with the real racing beginning from the second-last fence. The lack of early pace pressure and relatively short trip heavily favours hold-up horses who can produce late kick - Royal Hollow, Mercury Mission, Beauforts Storm, The Goose's Acre and Charity Barnum all get ideal conditions to unleash finishing efforts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate as expected with Pinot Gris getting easy lead
scenarios.body: The lack of early burn-up allows closers to conserve energy and time their runs perfectly from the back. Royal Hollow and Mercury Mission benefit most from this patient tempo.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Son Of Anarchy or Goldinthemountains can get first run on the turn
scenarios.body: They catch Pinot Gris before the hold-up horses can respond, using their forward position advantage. Son Of Anarchy's class edge and Goldinthemountains' in-form trainer angle both appeal.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pinot Gris Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runner gets too easy a time and quickens approaching the last
scenarios.body: His 32-day break keeps him fresh enough to repel late challengers despite recent poor form. The De Bromhead/O'Keeffe combination adds tactical nous.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If no one pressures early and it becomes a crawling contest
scenarios.body: The race turns into a pure sprint finish where any horse can win regardless of position. Jockey experience becomes crucial in a bunched finale.

watchPoints.text: Pinot Gris getting too easy a lead - if no one tracks him closely early, he could steal it despite poor form

Mercury Mission and amateur jockey Liam McKenna in tactical finish - inexperience could cost in tight finish
Son Of Anarchy's jumping - any mistake when travelling well could hand race to hold-up horses behind
Going deterioration through card - later races becoming softer could disadvantage those who prefer better ground

races.paceDynamic: Coral River will set the early pace with The Great Nudie and Nas Na Riogh tracking close behind in the prominent positions. With four hold-up horses (Great Universe, Kamikaz Du Plessis, Littlefoot, Ad Caelum) settling at the back, this creates a steady tempo rather than a fierce gallop. The pace-setters won't be under severe pressure early, allowing for a more genuine test of stamina over the 2m4f trip on softening ground. This sustainable pace followed by a climb to the finish clearly favours prominent runners who can stay handy and kick when needed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays manageable and the prominent horses maintain good jumping rhythm
scenarios.body: The Great Nudie and Coral River will have ideal positions to strike turning for home, with their proven stamina and soft ground form giving them every chance. The hold-up horses will find the steady gallop and testing conditions difficult to overcome from the rear.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners go too fast early or make jumping errors under pressure
scenarios.body: Great Universe or Littlefoot can use their class and finishing kick to sweep past tiring leaders in the final furlong. Their patient tactics become an advantage if the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Coral River doesn't go forward or gets hampered early leaving no clear leader
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair with stop-start fractions, allowing any horse with a turn of foot to win regardless of position. Jockey tactics and timing become more important than running style.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the soft ground rides deeper than expected and creates a true slog from the back straight
scenarios.body: Only the most genuine stayers will be in contention at the finish, with trip and ground specialists coming to the fore. Jumping becomes secondary to raw stamina.

watchPoints.text: Coral River's jumping under pressure - if he makes an early mistake the pace scenario changes completely
Great Universe's stamina over 2m4f on testing ground - his last win was over shorter and he's now 10 years old

Kamikaz Du Plessis early in the race - if Jack Kennedy sends him forward it signals the pace will be stronger than expected

races.paceDynamic: Luciole Des Bordes will take them along from the front with Gortnaclea Castle for company, creating a measured but honest gallop in this small field. The lack of genuine speed horses means the pace will be steady rather than searching, allowing the field to stay bunched for longer. With five hold-up horses including Giorgia Rose and On A Diamond waiting to pounce, the race will develop into a sprint from the final half-mile. This pace shape strongly favours prominent racers who can avoid trouble and kick clear when the hold-up brigade inevitably gets shuffled back in the rush.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Luciole Des Bordes and Gortnaclea Castle dictate throughout and kick clear approaching the final furlong
scenarios.body: The honest pace suits their stamina profiles perfectly while the hold-up horses get caught flat-footed when the leaders quicken. Both have shown they can handle similar going conditions and the distance plays to their strengths.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses time their runs to perfection and catch the leaders tiring
scenarios.body: Giorgia Rose or On A Diamond could have untapped ability that allows them to sweep past tired leaders in the final 100 yards. The lightly-raced pair represent the biggest unknown quantities with potential upside.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Steady Pace Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a crawl until the final quarter-mile
scenarios.body: Thelittleballerina gets the perfect setup for her hold-up style and can use her proven stamina to outlast classier rivals in a sprint finish. Her recent third at this distance on similar going suggests she's in good heart.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If traffic problems develop in the straight and the well-positioned horses benefit from clear runs
scenarios.body: The small field could still create interference issues if the hold-up horses all move at once, allowing a horse like Myluckymaker to benefit from a trouble-free passage. Her trainer's poor recent form could be masking improved ability.

watchPoints.text: Watch for Giorgia Rose's market movement as any support would suggest hidden ability in this lightly-raced mare
Monitor how Luciole Des Bordes breaks from the stalls after 59 days off as rustiness could compromise her prominent style
Keep an eye on traffic developing in the straight as five hold-up horses could create serious interference issues
Watch for On A Diamond's debut performance as a four-year-old newcomer could spring a surprise if showing natural ability
Check if the going deteriorates further as several runners have shown their best form on softer surfaces
